messages.en:
{07 16 00}What are you doing,
{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} Are you trying
to do this?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mida sa teed,
{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas sa üritad
seda teha?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Once you get the hang of
it, {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}is
easy to express!

{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} is easy
to show once you put a
little heart into it.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} on lihtne
näidata, kui paned sellesse
natuke südant.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'll do it again, so watch
closely,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Teen seda uuesti, nii et
vaata hoolega,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}See!{01 00 00 0a 00} It's a piece of cake,
isn't it?{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}Do you get it?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Näed!{01 00 00 0a 00} See on ju lapsemäng,
kas pole?{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}Kas saad aru?

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh.{01 00 00 0a 00} Really?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} OK. I'll do it for
you one more time. {01 00 00 0a 00}Keep
your eyes glued to me!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh.{01 00 00 0a 00} Tõesti?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} Olgu. Teen
seda veel korra. {01 00 00 0a 00}Hoia
silmad mul küljes!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Now you've learned how to
show {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00},
too, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Yep, that's one more thing
you can check off your
to-do list!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nüüd oskad ka sina näidata
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Jaa, üks asi veel, mille
saad oma nimekirjast
maha tõmmata!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Like {ff 00 00 06}Dr. Shrunk{ff 00 00 00} says, you
gotta express your
feelings! {01 00 00 05 00}And I feel hungry!
But anyway,{01 00 00 05 00} you can express
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}now!{01 00 00 05 00}
Hooray, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nagu {ff 00 00 06}dr Shrunk{ff 00 00 00} ütleb, sa
pead oma tundeid
väljendama! {01 00 00 05 00}Ja mul on nälg!
Igatahes,{01 00 00 05 00} nüüd oskad
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}väljendada!{01 00 00 05 00}
Hurraa, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} but you can't learn any
more expressions than this!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Your brain's all stuffed up!
{07 1b 00}Maybe you should forget
some of those {ff 00 00 02}expressions
{ff 00 00 00}you don't use anymore.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} aga rohkem väljendeid
sa õppida ei saa!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Su aju on puupüsti täis!
{07 1b 00}Vahest peaksid unustama
mõned {ff 00 00 02}väljendid
{ff 00 00 00}, mida enam ei kasuta.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You must be awfully
confused with all the
{ff 00 00 02}expressions{ff 00 00 00} you've learned.
{07 00 00}If you don't forget a few
of them, you won't be able
to learn any more.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sul peab olema kohutavalt
segane kõigist neist
{ff 00 00 02}väljenditest{ff 00 00 00}, mis õppisid.
{07 00 00}Kui sa mõnda neist ei
unusta, ei saa sa rohkem
juurde õppida.

{07 00 00}Tõesti? {07 15 00}Olgu! Proovin
korra{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00} {07 05 00}{01 08 00}HEEEEEE-JAA!
{07 14 00}Nii! Sa unustasid, kuidas
väljendada {ff 00 00 02}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00},
aga ära muretse!
{07 0a 00}Sa õppisid väljendama
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}Jihuu!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hmm.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00} If that's what you
want, I don't mind. I'm
gonna go eat a cookie.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hmm.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00} Kui sa seda tahad,
pole mul midagi vastu.
Ma lähen küpsist sööma.
